query:
SELECT pd.equipamentoId, COUNT(pdi.id) as totalItens
FROM parte_diaria pd
LEFT JOIN parte_diaria_itens pdi ON pdi.parteDiariaId = pd.id
WHERE pd.equipamentoId IN (29, 20, 40, 38, 37, 86, 91, 50, 87)
AND pd.data >= '2026-04-01' AND pd.data <= '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY pd.equipamentoId
